about_the_game:
Are There Bunny Girls in the Corner Store? is a lighthearted and charming visual novel set in a seemingly ordinary convenience store with an extraordinary staff. You’ll drop by for snacks, but end up staying for conversations with the quirky, alluring bunny girls who work there, each with her own personality and secrets behind the counter.

Genre: Visual Novel + Slice of Life + Light Romance

Setting: A cozy city-side corner store where fantasy meets everyday life

Main Role: You’re an ordinary customer whose curiosity (and maybe heart) keeps bringing him back

Romance Path:

  • Grow closer through honest moments and playful teasing

  • Choose how deep you want to get involved — customer, friend, or something more

  • Unlock new story scenes and endings depending on who you connect with most

Features:

  •  Meet a cast of unique bunny girl employees, each with distinct personalities

  •  Enjoy slice-of-life moments with playful humor and gentle romance

  • Explore small choices that change your relationships and story events

  • Relax in a warm, feel-good world with a touch of fantasy charm

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, 11
  • Processor: Dual Core or better
  • Memory: 200 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GT 750 or better, AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: A cozy, flirty visual novel set in a small corner store with an unexpected twist, the clerks are all bunny girls. Visit daily, chat, and uncover their secrets as you fall into the charm of Corner Store 24. You came for snacks… but stayed for something sweeter.
